method: Sonnet subagents, 6 groups of 5, full source inputs_v3 (every line read), conflicts only; each reported item checked by the main session against the cited lines.
rule_for_false: not a conflict: whole-programme or operating window, a different programme starting at another time, a 예시/daily routine, a garbled line, or the early-weeks note
